int_name: N 17TH ST & CECIL B MOORE AVE

result.summary: The intersection features a sidewalk and a traffic signal but lacks essential pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. The one-way street has poor pavement quality and parked vehicles that may obstruct sightlines at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible, which fails to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The curb is continuous without ramps, creating a barrier for individuals with mobility impairments.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven road surface can pose a tripping hazard for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct curb ramps with tactile paving to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of continuous sidewalks in good condition within a mixed-use urban setting. However, the intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, and a large bus creates a significant visual obstruction for crossing.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large bus is stopped near the intersection, blocking sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While vehicle signals are present, there are no dedicated pedestrian signal heads to indicate safe crossing times.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear guidance for crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility of pedestrians to drivers by moving them past parked vehicles or obstructions.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic sidewalk infrastructure and traffic signals but lacks marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. Parked vehicles along the curb create significant sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross the unmarked roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
